events.title: The GreenRoots Collective: Environmental Technology Workshops

cases.refreshed: Discover how science and engineering can be used to understand and solve real environmental challenges. In this hands-on Green Roots Collective workshop series, students will explore sustainability through interactive experiments, engineering challenges, collaborative problem-solving, and community-focused projects. Sustainability is becoming an increasingly important part of the world students are growing up in. Understanding how the environment works, and how everyday decisions, technology, and engineering can help protect it, gives young learners the tools to think critically about real-world problems and envision better solutions for the future. Rather than simply learning environmental concepts, students will put them into practice. Each workshop introduces a scientific idea, gives students the opportunity to investigate it through a hands-on activity, and challenges them to apply what they learn to a practical solution. Students will also contribute to community projects that connect their learning to meaningful action beyond the classroom. Through the program, participants will strengthen scientific reasoning, engineering design, creativity, teamwork, and problem-solving skills while developing a deeper understanding of sustainability and how STEM can be used to create positive change. Series Topics: 1. Floodproof! The Science & Engineering of El Niño - November 8 2. Cooler Cities: Engineering Solutions to Urban Heat - November 20 3. Clean Air Lab: The Science of Pollution & Filtration - December 13 4. Microplastics Lab: Investigating Tiny Plastics in Our Environment - December 18 Ages: 7-12 Registration Recommended!

cases.refreshed: The worlds of science and art collide at STEAM Sundays. We'll provide the supplies, you bring your curious and creative energy! For November, we'll be celebrating the fall season as we create sensory bottles. We'll discuss density, buoyancy, mixtures, and solutions, then we'll explore what we learned as we combine ingredients for our craft. We'll also chat about seasonal changes, how they impact the world around us, and how sensory objects can help us refocus and reset. Participants will leave with their very own ready-to-use sensory bottle. Through a brief lecture and hands-on experimenting and creating, STEAM Sundays allow participants to learn about science, technology, engineering, and math while working on an art project. After learning about a topic, the experimentation and note taking parts of the scientific process will be conducted through a craft. Everyone will go home with a finished project and better understanding of each chosen topic. Best for youth ages 5-12. Supplies are limited; registration required. STEAM Sunday: Botellas Sensoriales de Otoño ¡Los mundos de la ciencia y arte se juntan en domingos STEAM. ¡Nosotros traemos los materiales, ¡tú solo ven con muchas ganas de explorar y crear! Este noviembre, celebraremos la temporada de otoño creando botellas sensoriales. Hablaremos sobre la densidad, la flotabilidad, las mezclas y las soluciones. Después, pondremos en práctica lo aprendido al combinar diferentes materiales para crear nuestra manualidad. También conversaremos sobre los cambios de estación, cómo afectan al mundo que nos rodea y cómo los objetos sensoriales pueden ayudarnos a recuperar la concentración y encontrar la calma. ¡Cada participante se llevará a casa su propia botella sensorial, lista para usar! A través de una breve lección, experimentos y creaciones práctica, los domingos STEAM permiten a los participantes aprender sobre ciencia, tecnología, ingeniería, y matemáticas mientras trabajan en un proyecto de arte. Después de aprender sobre cierto tema, la experimentación y el tomar apuntes de este proceso científico se llevarán a cabo por medio de una artesanía. Todos irán a casa con un proyecto terminado y con un mejor entendimiento de cada tema elegido. Para niños y niñas de 5 a 12 años. Los materiales son limitados. Se requiere inscripción previa.
